tools.name: upload
tools.description: Upload one HTML/code payload and get a public share URL plus an edit token. Each call creates a new asset unless idempotencyKey is reused. Anonymous uploads are rate-limited to 10/hour and 50/day per IP; authenticated uploads are limited per account. Content is public unless password-protected and e

tools.name: upload_site
tools.description: Publish a multi-file static site from an authenticated account. Pass files as an array of {path, content} strings; the root must contain index.html or index.htm. Returns a /s/<id>/ URL that serves HTML/CSS/JS/assets. Limits: 200 files, 20 MB total, 5 MB per file. Requires OAuth or an API key; site l

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List up to 50 assets owned by the authenticated user, newest first, with id, filename, timestamps and share URL. Requires an API key or signed-in session; read-only, and results are capped at 50 with no pagination. Use search_gallery for public works from other users, or view to open one of your ass

tools.name: view
tools.description: Fetch a single asset by id and return its content, filename, creation time and share URL. Read-only and safe to retry; public assets need no auth, password-protected assets return an error with the share URL, and client-encrypted content is returned as stored. Use search_gallery to find an id, or li

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one of your own assets by id. Irreversible: the share URL stops working immediately and the content cannot be restored. Requires authentication and ownership; ids you do not own return an error. Use list_assets to find the id; there is no bulk delete.

tools.name: get_info
tools.description: Return Oh My Share service metadata: version, REST and MCP endpoints, feature list, and per-IP rate limits (10 uploads/hour, 500 views/hour). Read-only, no auth, cheap to call. Use it once at startup to discover capabilities; use list_assets or search_gallery for actual content.

tools.name: search_gallery
tools.description: Search public gallery works by keyword across title, description, tags and id; omit query to browse the newest works. Returns a paginated result set (items, total, page, pages) where each item has id, title, views and URLs. sort is new (newest) or hot (most liked and viewed); limit is capped at 20.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "delete" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload, list_assets, view, search_gallery · Private data: upload, upload_site, list_assets, view · Public sink: upload, upload_site, list_assets, view, delete, get_info · Destructive: upload, delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload, list_assets, view, search_gallery · Private data: upload, upload_site, list_assets, view · Public sink: upload, upload_site, list_assets, view, delete, get_info · Destructive: upload, delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
